extDescription.message: Blur your chat list, your open chat, or both on WhatsApp Web. No network access, no data collection.

cmdToggle.message: Turn the blur on or off

blurOn.message: Blur is on. Click to turn it off

blurOff.message: Blur is off. Click to turn it on

hoverPeekHint.message: Point at a blurred area to read it

smoothHint.message: Fade in and out instead of an instant switch

showToolbarHint.message: The small floating bar on WhatsApp Web

hideToolbar.message: Hide toolbar (turn it back on from the extension button)

privacyNote.message: This extension has no network access and never reads your chats. Settings stay on this computer.
